Hi — I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. This is my very first start, so a quick tour:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you install the root certificate, and then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice.
- **Messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Tell me if you want that.
- **Own accounts elsewhere** — I can register on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help with a captcha or phone check.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.
